analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see stance for the past 2 consecutive sessions. RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram continues to worsen in negative territory. The 5-day low of 711.68 is forming a Higher Low pattern relative to the 20-day low of 660.80, attempting a rebound near the support level of 731.00, but the volume ratio of 0.89 indicates a lack of momentum. This aligns with the overall market's QQQ decline. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach in the current phase.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($737.54) vs SMA5 ($736.51)/SMA20 ($730.82)/SMA50 ($649.59): Short-term/mid-term trend above, mid-term trend in strong alignment.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($625.22)/SMA200 ($630.44): Mid-to-long-term trend showing bullish dominance.
· 52-week position (83.7%) + Diagnosis of current price range near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (57.7→58.1) + Consolidation in neutral zone, weakening directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-3.5579→-3.5411) + Holding in negative territory with slight improvement, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $730.82) + Bandwidth at 13.25%, consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($731.00) + Support confirmed based on SMA20.
· Swing Resistance ($740.91) + Pullback phase relative to 52-week high of $779.82.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) + Attempting recovery but lacking volume.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.89x) + Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Pullback within an uptrend) + Condition for maintaining a wait-and-see approach upon recovery of support at 731.00, with consideration for a buy signal upon breakout.
